title: Unlocking the Potential of Curcumae Rhizoma Aqueous Extract in Stress Resistance and Extending Lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans.
authors: Jing, Linyao; Zhao, Yanlin; Jiang, Lijun; Song, Fei; An, Lu; Qi, Edmund; Fu, Xueqi; Chen, Jing; Ma, Junfeng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药莪术水提物在秀丽隐杆线虫中的抗应激与延寿作用，涉及网络药理学和分子对接，但核心对象非蛋白质-DNA互作，无AI/物理模拟结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: The enhancement of stress resistance is crucial for delaying aging and extending a healthy lifespan. Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM), a cherished treasure of Chinese heritage, has shown potential in mitigating stress and promoting longevity. This study integrates network pharmacology and in vivo analysis to investigate the mechanisms and effects of Curcumae Rhizoma (C. Rhizoma), known as "E Zhu" in Chinese. Ultra-Performance Liquid Chromatography-Tandem Mass Spectrometry (UPLC-MS/MS) identified 10 active compounds in its aqueous extract, interacting with 128 stress-related targets. Gene Ontology (GO) and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) analyses revealed pathways such as stress response, FoxO signaling, and insulin resistance. In Caenorhabditis elegans, 10 mg/mL of C. Rhizoma aqueous extract improved resistance to UV, thermal, oxidative, and pathogen-induced stress, extending lifespan in a dose-dependent manner. Mechanistically, it reduced reactive oxygen species (ROS), increased superoxide dismutase (SOD) activity, and enhanced UV resistance via the insulin/IGF-1 pathway and DAF-16 translocation. Molecular docking highlighted hexahydrocurcumin (HHC) and related compounds as key bioactives. Furthermore, we also observed that C. Rhizoma aqueous extract significantly extended both the lifespan and healthspan of nematodes. These findings highlight the potential of C. Rhizoma in stress mitigation and longevity promotion, offering valuable insights into the therapeutic applications of TCM.
abstract_zh: 增强抗逆性对于延缓衰老和延长健康寿命至关重要。中药（TCM）作为中华文化的瑰宝，在缓解压力和促进长寿方面显示出潜力。本研究整合网络药理学和体内分析，探讨莪术（C. Rhizoma）的机制和效果，中文名为“E Zhu”。超高效液相色谱-串联质谱（UPLC-MS/MS）鉴定出其水提物中的10种活性化合物，与128个应激相关靶点相互作用。基因本体论（GO）和京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）分析揭示了应激反应、FoxO信号传导和胰岛素抵抗等通路。在秀丽隐杆线虫中，10 mg/mL的莪术水提物提高了对紫外线、热、氧化和病原体诱导应激的抵抗力，并以剂量依赖性方式延长寿命。机制上，它通过胰岛素/IGF-1通路和DAF-16转位减少活性氧（ROS）、增加超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）活性，并增强紫外线抗性。分子对接突出六氢姜黄素（HHC）及相关化合物为关键生物活性成分。此外，我们还观察到莪术水提物显著延长了线虫的寿命和健康寿命。这些发现凸显了莪术在缓解压力和促进长寿方面的潜力，为中药的治疗应用提供了宝贵见解。
